annotation.evidence_span: three times or more larger than the packet it receives
annotation.interpretation_a: The stateless reset can be up to three times the size of the received packet, but not larger. A packet of 1000 bytes could trigger a reset of 3000 bytes.
annotation.interpretation_b: The stateless reset must be strictly less than three times the size of the received packet. A packet of 1000 bytes could not trigger a reset of 3000 bytes, only 2999.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'three times or more' is ambiguous. It is unclear whether a reset that is exactly three times the size of the received packet is permitted or not. This affects the maximum size of the reset packet and therefore implementation behaviour.
annotation.missing_information: The phrase 'three times or more' is ambiguous. Does 'or more' mean any amount over three times, or is it inclusive of three times?
